The best plan costs **154**. One trip brings back the 2 elderly people and the 2 children, and the adult is deferred.

**Why defer the adult:** The only open route to Syaphru temple goes through Uttargaya school and Nilkantha market, because the direct shelter–Nilkantha road is impassable. A round trip that collects both locations takes 67 + 39 + 28 = 134 minutes. The car has 4 seats but 5 people are waiting.

| Option | Calculation | Cost |
|---|---|---|
| Defer the adult | 134 driving + 20 penalty | **154** |
| Bring everyone (second 56-minute trip for one child) | 134 + 56 | 190 |
| Defer everyone at Syaphru, rescue only the children | 56 driving + 120 penalties | 176 |
| Defer everyone | 240 in penalties | 240 |

<plan>
drive car1 myagang-shelter uttargaya-school
drive car1 uttargaya-school nilkantha-market
drive car1 nilkantha-market syaphru-temple
load car1 elderly 2
defer syaphru-temple adult 1
drive car1 syaphru-temple nilkantha-market
drive car1 nilkantha-market uttargaya-school
load car1 child 2
drive car1 uttargaya-school myagang-shelter
unload car1 elderly 2
unload car1 child 2
</plan>

COST: 154
